snippet.title: Strato (My first android game!)
snippet.description:
v1.0.3 gameplay: http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OYT_LJz76zI
I just posted my first android game!

Free (ad banner supported):
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.lemec.Strato

$1.00 (no ads) version:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.lemec.StratoPro

If I make $100 from mobile sales, I'll be able to put it up a PC version for Steam Greenlight!
